articles.headline: Micron, Nvidia, AMD on Watch as Asia's Chip Selloff Sends Warning to Wall Street
articles.summary: Chip-stocks plunge after brutal overnight session in South Korea, as US semiconductor names extend losses in premarket trading.
articles._summary: The chip-stock bloodbath that started in Seoul overnight is crossing the Pacific — and Wall Street’s premarket screens are flashing red. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, tracked by the iShares PHLX SOX Semiconductor Sector Index Fund (NASDAQ: SOXX ) , shed about 2% in the prior session. The trigger was a brutal overnight session in South Korea, where the Kospi slumped 10.8% as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix — down 13.4% and 14.7%, respectively — got hit by a wave of retail-leverage unwind.

articles.headline: The AI Memory Trade Is Crumbling: SanDisk, Micron and Western Digital Extend Brutal Selloff
articles.summary: SanDisk, Micron and Western Digital have lost up to 52% since June. Is China ending the AI memory boom, or is Wall Street overreacting?
articles._summary: Just a month ago, memory was Wall Street’s favorite AI trade. Today, it has become one of the market’s biggest casualties . Since their late-June highs, SanDisk has tumbled over 50%, SK Hynix has dropped about 47%, Micron and Western Digital are each down more than 32%, and Seagate has lost about 30%.

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Trump's Zombie Tariffs Are Back— and Top Economist Justin Wolfers Says It's a 'Never-Ending 24/7 Saga'
articles.summary: Economist Justin Wolfers breaks down Trump's 99% "zombie tariffs," revealing why the forced labor loophole is a 24/7 nightmare for the US.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump ’s sweeping import taxes have returned from the dead, earning the moniker “zombie tariffs,” and economists warn the chaotic policy is wreaking havoc on U.S. businesses. Economist Justin Wolfers described the constantly shifting trade directives as a “never-ending 24/7 saga” punishing consumers instead of sparking a manufacturing boom. Experts argue the policy’s design reveals its true intent. Countries deemed “really bad” face a 12.5% tariff, while “merely bad” nations get a 10% rate.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普的僵尸关税卷土重来——顶级经济学家贾斯汀·沃尔弗斯称这是一个“永无休止的 24/7 传奇”
articles._zh_summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的全面进口税死而复生，赢得了“僵尸关税”的绰号，经济学家警告说，混乱的政策正在对美国企业造成严重破坏。经济学家贾斯汀·沃尔弗斯 (Justin Wolfers) 将不断变化的贸易指令描述为“永无休止的 24/7 传奇”，它不仅没有引发制造业繁荣，反而惩罚了消费者。专家认为，该政策的设计揭示了其真实意图。被认为“非常糟糕”的国家面临 12.5% 的关税，而“非常糟糕”的国家则面临 10% 的关税。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Is the AI Boom A 'Virtuous Circle' Or a Ponzi Scheme? Wall Street Is Split
articles.summary: Are Nvidia's billion-dollar deals a 'virtuous circle' or a tech bubble? Dive into the expert debate on the risks of AI circular financing.
articles._summary: The artificial intelligence boom has sparked a web of interwoven investments, leaving market watchers divided on whether this trend represents a “virtuous circle” of strategic alignment or a perilous tech echo chamber masking true demand. Conversely, Janus Henderson said that these mega-deals are a “virtuous circle” that efficiently aligns builders, suppliers, and customers to meet unprecedented computing demand. However, industry executives maintain that such arrangements solve a genuine capital bottleneck.
articles._zh_headline: 人工智能热潮是“良性循环”还是庞氏骗局？华尔街分裂
articles._zh_summary: 人工智能的繁荣引发了一系列相互交织的投资，市场观察人士对于这一趋势是否代表战略联盟的“良性循环”，还是掩盖真实需求的危险的科技回声室产生了分歧。相反，Janus Henderson 表示，这些大型交易是一个“良性循环”，可以有效地协调构建商、供应商和客户，以满足前所未有的计算需求。然而，行业高管坚持认为，这种安排解决了真正的资本瓶颈。

articles._summary: Micron remains one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI memory boom, but recent price action suggests investors are reassessing how long strong high-bandwidth memory (HBM) demand, pricing power and hyperscaler spending can sustain the sector’s rally. articles.headline: Why Is SK hynix Stock Falling Tuesday?
articles.summary: SK hynix stock fell over 3% premarket ahead of Q2 earnings amid an AI tech sell-off. See why investors are exiting memory chipmakers.
articles._summary: The stock has shifted from one of the hottest AI memory trades to a major test of investor confidence as concerns over crowded positioning, China competition, and hyperscaler spending weigh on the sector. Pictet Asset Management’s Andy Wong said investors are debating whether memory makers are capturing too much of the AI supply-chain economics. He said the market wants to see whether anything changes the perception that SK Hynix is extracting excessive margin from customers.

articles.summary: Over $1T was wiped from U.S. stocks Monday, with more than half the losses concentrated in six memory-related chip stocks.
articles._summary: More than $1 trillion was wiped from U.S. stocks on Monday, with over half of the losses concentrated in just six memory-related names as investors dumped the sector on fears that China could expand domestic chip production. Together, the six companies erased approximately $541 billion in market capitalization during Monday’s selloff. The development is expected to help Chinese chipmakers expand manufacturing capacity using homegrown equipment, fueling concerns over future memory-chip supply and pricing.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达、SK 海力士、美光和内存股因中国芯片担忧重挫，损失超过 1 万亿美元：值得关注的 ETF
articles._zh_summary: 周一，美国股市蒸发了超过 1 万亿美元，其中一半以上的损失集中在六只与内存相关的股票上，投资者因担心中国可能扩大国内芯片产量而抛售该行业。在周一的抛售中，这六家公司的市值总计蒸发了约 5,410 亿美元。这一进展预计将帮助中国芯片制造商利用国产设备扩大制造能力，引发人们对未来存储芯片供应和定价的担忧。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: China Is Coming For SanDisk—But Not Yet For Micron’s Memory Crown (CORRECTED)
articles.summary: Analyst MS Hwang says China is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND, but the HBM market still belongs to the incumbents.
articles._summary: Editor’s Note: This story has been corrected to remove an inaccurate company reference. China, however, is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND . That’s according to Counterpoint Research analyst MS Hwang , who told Benzinga in an interview that “Chinese vendors are catching up quickly in commodity DRAM and NAND. Yet, the HBM is difficult to catch up.” He added: “I think China vendors can manufacture HBM3 in 1H 2027.”
articles._zh_headline: 独家报道：中国正在为 SanDisk 而来，但尚未为 Micron 的内存皇冠而来（已更正）
articles._zh_summary: 编者注：本文已更正，删除了不准确的公司参考信息。然而，中国在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速进步。 Counterpoint Research 分析师 MS Hwang 在接受 Benzinga 采访时表示，“中国供应商在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速追赶。然而，HBM 很难追赶。”他补充道：“我认为中国供应商可以在 2027 年上半年生产 HBM3。”
